lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, the joy of loving hearts,
The salt of life,
The light of man
From the best bliss that earth imparts We
Turn our fill to you again

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Your truth unchanged has ever stood
You save all those that on you call To
Them that seek you,
You are good To
Them that find you all in all
We taste you, O thou living bread
And long to feast upon you still We drink of you the fountainhead
Our thirst to quench our

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Souls to fill
Our restless spirits
Yearn for you
Where'er our changeful lot is cast
Glad when your gracious smile we see
Blessed when our faith can hold you fast

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Won't Jesus ever with us stay?
Make all our moments calm and bright
Chase the dark night of sin away
Shadow the world your holy light
